actions.motion: BOARD ORDER, HELD, COUNTY COUNSEL READ: IN THE MATTER OF VEDANTA SOCIETY OF SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA V. OC PARKS DISTRICT, THE BOARD UNANIMOUSLY APPROVED A PROPOSED SETTLEMENT WITH THE VEDANTA SOCIETY OF SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA (“VEDANTA”) TO RESOLVE A LONG- STANDING PROPERTY DISPUTE OVER 245 ACRES OF PARK LAND GRANTED TO THE COUNTY IN THE 1970S. AMONG OTHER TERMS, THE SETTLEMENT APPROVED TODAY TRANSFERS TITLE OF MONASTERY ROAD TO VEDANTA AND INCLUDES A $250,000 PAYMENT TO VEDANTA FOR REPAIR OF THAT ROAD. THE SETTLEMENT APPROVED TODAY IS SUBJECT TO THE FINAL APPROVAL OF OTHERS AND WHEN THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IS FINALIZED, COPIES OF THE AGREEMENT WILL BE MADE AVAILABLE FROM THE OFFICE OF COUNTY COUNSEL TO ANY PERSON WHO INQUIRES.
